question: In the biodiesel produced over GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4, what combined area percentage do the two unsaturated methyl esters (methyl linoleate and methyl oleate) make up?
rendered:
Based on the information provided in the first document, specifically on page 20, the combined area percentage of the two unsaturated methyl esters (methyl linoleate and methyl oleate) is calculated as follows:

Methyl linoleate (C19:2) area percentage = 20.51%
Methyl oleate (C19:1) area percentage = 27.81%

Combined area percentage = 20.51% + 27.81% = 48.32%

Therefore, the combined area percentage of the two unsaturated methyl esters (methyl linoleate and methyl oleate) in the biodiesel produced over GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4 is 48.32%.
